scope: One synchronized public-summary burst from ten native Supabase Edge generators in eu-west-2. No report submissions, files or Telegram sends.
concurrency_definition: Sum of measured outstanding HTTP request intervals across synchronized generators; waiting for transport or response consumption is included. This does not count database connections.
duration_limitations: A single burst does not establish sustained or regional capacity, cold-cache performance, or production report throughput.

unit_results.scope: One unit of a synchronized native-HTTP read-only burst; no report submissions or files
unit_results.concurrency_definition: HTTP requests awaiting completion; transport and edge caching are included. This does not measure database write concurrency.
